coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches across four high-value miss classes: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss; disaster-related emergency food distribution cancellations; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or access reduction; and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new qualifying signal was found in the observation window. Previously known El Paso food-bank storm damage and older grocery/SNAP/WIC items were treated as duplicates or outside the window; donation drives, routine resource/promotion items, and unsupported/non-access-impact material were excluded.
